summary: Iteration 38 — CRM Finance regularizations & filters. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_38_finance_regularizations.py with 34 tests covering: (1) admin login + finance access; (2) recompute endpoint OWNER-only + summary structure (documents_total/documents_reclassified/clients_updated/changes_by_class); (3) THE BUG SCENARIO — FT 0.80€/1220d classifies as 'residual' after recompute; (4) MICRO_OLD scenario 3.50€/500d → micro_old; (5) COLLECTABLE 500€/45d → collectable; (6) 3.50€/100d stays collectable (days<=365); (7) /regularizations returns per-document with all required fields (document_id, document_type, document_number, amount_open, days_overdue, classification, client_name, genes_code, client_residual_balance, client_residual_document_count, suggestion_code, suggestion_label); (8) filters only_micro_old / only_residual / only_low_values / min_amount / max_amount / min_days / max_days / search; (9) sort_by (days_overdue/amount_open) × sort_dir (asc/desc); (10) suggestion_code=='validate_old_invoice' for micro_old; (11) mark_collectable removes doc from /regularizations; (12) reset restores residual and puts doc back in /regularizations; (13) mark_dispute → effective_classification='dispute'; (14) mark_resolved_operationally → 'resolved_operationally'; (15) regularize_internally keeps residual/micro_old classification; (16) document_id with slash uses :path converter (POST /documents/FT_023%2F1115_.../action works); (17) 404 on unknown doc; (18) /collections/today all sort_by options accepted + invalid rejected 422; (19) filters min_overdue/max_overdue/min_days/max_days/only_low_values/only_old_docs/financial_status/search all constrain output correctly; (20) PUT /settings triggers auto-recompute. ALL 34/34 PASS. Frontend: verified /finance/regularizations renders with all 16 required data-testids (page, refresh, totals×3, search, min/max amount, min/max days, sort_by, sort_dir, toggle micro-old/residual/low-values, reset, active-filters-count) — filters interact correctly, action dialog opens with reason input. /finance/collections-today renders when data-health OK, exposes all 12 filter data-testids including the collapsible advanced-filters panel; sort select shows all 10 options. Data-health showed 'blocked' state initially due to no recent import in preview — this is EXPECTED UX (unrelated to this change).

issues: React hydration warning: `<span>` (Emergent tracker's <span data-ve-dynamic>) is being injected as a direct child of <tbody> and around <tr>. Not a functional bug — the table renders correctly and testids are found — but it produces two console errors in dev mode. This is caused by the emergent visual-editor wrapper, not by Regularizations.js code. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: classify_document() in import_service.py:124 correctly enforces the new rule: `amount_open <= residual_document_threshold` returns RESIDUAL BEFORE any % check — the 0.80€/1220d bug is fixed at the root.

recompute_documents_and_clients() correctly separates `classification` (algorithmic) from `effective_classification` (post-manual-override) — respects manually_marked_collectable / manual_action for dispute / resolved_operationally. Aggregates use effective_classification, so a `mark_collectable` on a residual immediately adds it to overdue_balance_collectable. Good.

Route order for /documents/{document_id:path}/action — because the converter is `:path`, ANY string (including slashes) is matched; confirmed via test with id='FT_023/1115_...' returning 200. However, be aware that this greedy converter would also match paths like /documents/abc/anything/action — if you ever add sibling routes under /documents/{id}/xxx, they must be declared BEFORE this one or the :path route will swallow them. Not an issue today.

apply_document_action calls recompute_documents_and_clients() synchronously inside the request — the full-doc recompute is O(N) over ALL documents in the DB. On small datasets (~20 docs in preview) it's <10ms, but with 10k+ docs this will make each doc action click a multi-second operation. Consider a per-client recompute helper (only aggregate the affected client), or make it async with a background job. Non-blocking for now.

In routes.py:_build_suggestion, the RESIDUAL_ACCUMULATED branch is present but the enum value is 'residual_accumulated' — code appears correct. However the frontend Regularizations.js may not render a distinct badge for RESIDUAL_ACCUMULATED (worth verifying in a future iteration).

regularizations query builds a $and with 3 clauses + $or — indexes on (client_id, classification, effective_classification, manually_marked_collectable, manual_action) would help; verified via pymongo that collection has no such compound index. Consider adding one if this becomes slow at scale.

CollectionsToday.js — the outer wrapper with data-testid='collections-today-page' is ONLY rendered when data is not blocked; when blocked, the JSX is a completely different tree. This is fine for UX but if tests need to always find the testid, consider moving it to the outermost fragment or renaming the blocked-state wrapper.

Frontend Regularizations.js triggers two React hydration warnings (span inside tbody/tr) — caused by the Emergent visual-editor's `<span data-ve-dynamic x-excluded='true' style={{display:'contents'}}>` wrapper injected between iterator and elements. This is a global concern (affects any dev-mode page with tables), not a Regularizations regression. Consider suppressing via structural refactor if the warnings clutter logs.
PUT /finance/settings correctly triggers auto-recompute only when threshold keys are in the payload — good separation from show_credit_warning_on_tickets which does not touch document classification.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all required data-testids present and interactive

seed_data_creation: The test suite creates one shared TEST_ client with 3 docs (residual 0.80€/1220d, micro_old 3.50€/500d, collectable 500€/45d) via a module-scope fixture; extra ad-hoc test docs are created + cleaned per-test for the slash-in-id and 100-day scenarios. All TEST_ rows are deleted in fixture teardown; verified 0 rows leaked after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-run: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iteration_38_finance_regularizations.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iteration_38.xml`. Tests hit the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and inject seed data via direct MongoDB (MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017, DB_NAME=test_database). All fixtures clean up automatically. For frontend, the /finance/collections-today page shows 'Cobranças Bloqueadas' when no fresh overdue_balances import exists — inject a finance_imports doc with status='imported' and as_of_date=today to bypass. The Regularizations page always renders (never blocks). React hydration warnings for span-in-tbody are from Emergent's dev-mode visual editor and can be ignored.
rca of the issue: N/A — all review items pass. The FT 023/1115 (0.80€/1220d) bug is verified fixed via the classify_document rule 5 (amount_open <= residual_document_threshold → RESIDUAL BEFORE any % check) and end-to-end via recompute + /regularizations listing.
